name: skill-hoonsoo
description: Read-only combined content and grammar review for saved local document revisions.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only advice whenever a document is saved.
interface.longDescription: Observes user-selected documents only after changes reach disk, then reviews content, structure, and grammar without modifying source files.
defaultPrompt: Use $hoonsoo with a local file path to review its content, structure, and grammar whenever it is saved.
Use $hoonsoo with a local file path and my additional review priorities, then wait for saved revisions.
